evidence: Matches the 'Utils/log/libs' label and edits cryptographic primitive support files (src/crypto/sha256.cpp, src/compat/cpuid.h, and src/random.cpp).
rationale: Implements MSVC intrinsics for CPU feature detection to hook into hardware-accelerated SHA-256 routines (SSE4.1, AVX2, and SHA-NI). Benchmark testing showed 5x to 10x faster hashing on supported Intel CPUs, but because it only affects MSVC builds and does not fix a bug or correctness issue in the primitives, it is deferrable.
